================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - SWINTSHWA
Version 9.2.9  -  Nhlangula 2026
================================================================================

TI-THEME TA ANIME letintshwa ta 33 ti joyina leta Demon Slayer, ti-effect ta mouse
ta ti-theme sweswi ti humelela hakunene endzeni ka After Effects, naswona Theme
Selector sweswi i dropdown yin'we leyi hleriweke kahle.

U NGA SI SUNGULA
- Nghenisa ehenhla ka version ya wena ya sweswi hi ZXP installer leyi u tolovelekeke
  ku yi tirhisa, kutani u sungula After Effects nakambe kan'we.
- Swilulamiso swa wena, theme, ti-preset ni ti-expression leti hlayisiweke swi ta hlayisiwa.

LESWINTSHWA: TI-THEME TA ANIME TA 33
- Swilulamiso swa Flex > THEME SELECTOR > THEME YA PANEL sweswi yi ni ntlawa wun'we wa anime yin'wana ni yin'wana:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) na Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Mutlangi un'wana ni un'wana u ni xivumbeko xa yena: leswi landzelaka mouse ya wena,
  nhlaselo loko u klika bututu, leswi humelelaka loko u khomile bututu ya ximatsi, na
  ku buluka endzhaku ka loko u khome kwalomu ka tisekoni ta 2.5.
- Ti vevukile ku fana ni ti-theme ta Demon Slayer: ti-effect ti tirha ntsena loko u
  fambisa mouse kumbe u klika. Tima EFFECT YA NTSONKWA leswaku ku sala mivala ntsena.

SWI CINCIWILE: THEME SELECTOR
- Tikarati ta Demon Slayer leti a ti ri ehansi ka THEME YA PANEL ti susiwile, hikwalaho
  Swilulamiso swa Flex swi komile. Hlawula theme yin'wana ni yin'wana eka dropdown ya
  THEME YA PANEL; yi pfuleka eka theme leyi u yi tirhisaka sweswi.
- Kurama na Baryon sweswi swi le ka ntlawa wa Naruto.

SWI LULAMISIWILE
- Ti-effect ta mouse ta ti-theme (mati, malangavi, rihati na swin'wana) hakanyingi a ti
  nga humeleli endzeni ka After Effects, hambi loko Optimised Mode yi timiwile. Minkarhi
  leyi panel hi yoxe a yi khomekile, na ku sungula loku tikaka, a swi tekiwa onge i
  theme leyi nonokaka, hikwalaho ti-effect a ti tima hi toxe. Sweswi, loko graphics card
  ya wena yi ti dirowa (eka makhomphyuta yo tala), minkarhi yoleyo yi endla ti-effect ti
  vevuka nkarhinyana ntsena.

LESWI NGA CINCIWANGIKI
- Ku nyika laisensi, activation ni link yin'wana ni yin'wana swi tirha kahle-kahle ku fana ni khale.
- Ti-theme ta 11 ta Demon Slayer ti languteka kahle-kahle ku fana ni le ka 9.2.8.
- Ti-tab ni switirhisiwa hinkwaswo leswin'wana swi tirha kahle-kahle ku fana ni le ka 9.2.8.
================================================================================

  endzhaku ka loko theme yi cincile. Sweswi yi tshama yi kombisa theme leyi tirhaka sweswi.
